'''Brian Caffo''' is a professor in the Department of Biostatistics at the [[Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.jhsph.edu/faculty/directory/profile/1320/Caffo/Brian|title=Brian S. Caffo - Faculty Directory - Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health|first=JH Bloomberg School of Public|last=Health|website=Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health|accessdate=29 November 2017}}</ref> He graduated from the Department of Statistics at the [[University of Florida]] in 2001, and from the Department of Mathematics at UF in 1995. His doctoral advisor was [[James G. Booth]]. He works in the fields of [[computational statistics]] and [[neuroinformatics]] and co-created the SMART working group.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.smart-stats.org|title=Home - smart-stats.org|website=Smart-stats.org|accessdate=29 November 2017}}</ref> He has been the recipient of the [[Presidential Early Career Award for Scientists and Engineers]], Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health Golden Apple and AMTRA teaching awards.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.jhsph.edu/news/stories/2008/golden-apple-award-bios-2008.html|title=2008 Golden Apple Award Winners|first=Christine|last=Grillo|website=Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health|date=29 May 2008 |accessdate=29 November 2017}}</ref>

He teaches several open online courses on the online learning platform [[Coursera]], including: Mathematical Biostatistics Boot Camp 1; Mathematical Biostatistics Boot Camp 2; Advanced Linear Models for Data Science 1: Least Squares; Advanced Linear Models for Data Science 2: Statistical Linear Models; Statistical Inference; Regression Models; Developing Data Products.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.coursera.org/instructor/~688901|title = Brian Caffo, PHD, Instructor}}</ref>
